ESPN College Hoops 2K5.name: ESPN College Hoops 2K5
ESPN College Hoops 2K5.summary: College Hoops 2K5 offers a comprehensive college basketball experience. Go through Legacy Mode to bring a small college respect and eventually earn a job with a major program. Go online to test your skills against players around the world.

Final Fantasy XII.name: Final Fantasy XII
Final Fantasy XII.summary: The game takes place in the fictional land of Ivalice, where the empires of Archadia and Rozarria are waging an endless war. Dalmasca, a small kingdom, is caught between the warring nations. When Dalmasca is annexed by Archadia, its princess, Ashe, creates a resistance movement. During the struggle, she meets Vaan, a young adventurer who dreams of commanding an airship. They are quickly joined by a band of allies; together, they rally against the tyranny of the Archadian Empire.

Fullmetal Alchemist and the Broken Angel.name: Fullmetal Alchemist and the Broken Angel
Fullmetal Alchemist and the Broken Angel.summary: Fullmetal Alchemist and the Broken Angel, is an action role-playing game developed by Racjin and published by Square Enix for the PlayStation 2 console and is the first ever Fullmetal Alchemist video game released. The game features an original story by Hiromu Arakawa. The game was released in Japan on December 25th 2003 and in North America on January 18, 2005.

Garfield.name: Garfield
Garfield.summary: Garfield lets you play the role of the fat cat himself. As Garfield, you must clean up Odie's mess before John comes home if you want to win a big piece of lasagna. It's a race against the clock as you explore fully interactive environments and interact with familiar characters from the Garfield show. The game also includes minigames that let you race, cook lasagna, and play classic console games.

Gran Turismo 3 - A-Spec.name: Gran Turismo 3: A-Spec
Gran Turismo 3 - A-Spec.summary: More than two years in the making, Gran Turismo 3 A-spec features over 150 detailed cars -- each composed of more than 4,000 polygons -- 60 beginner, amateur and professional championship races, as well as ten endurance races and ten rally races. In addition to all-new special effects, such as sun glare, heat distortion and reflections, Gran Turismo 3 A-spec also offers up a soundtrack of more than 20 licensed tracks, and an even better replay mode with TV-style camera views. Two players can go head-to-head via split-screen and up to six can duke it out by linking multiple systems together via i.LINK. Released worldwide in 2001, Gran Turismo 3 a-Spec was designed by Polyphony Digital.

Hajime no Ippo - Victorious Boxers - Cha.name: Hajime no Ippo: Victorious Boxers - Championship Version
Hajime no Ippo - Victorious Boxers - Cha.summary: Hajime no Ippo: Victorious Boxers - Championship Version is the expanded version of Hajime no Ippo: Victorious Boxers, released in Japan only in June 27, 2002

Harukanaru Toki no Naka de - Maihitoyo.name: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de: Maihitoyo
Harukanaru Toki no Naka de - Maihitoyo.summary: Based on the movie of the same name, this game is a re-telling of the original Harukanaru Toki no Naka De 1, where the story is based in a different setting and with a new character added.

Jissen Pachi-Slot Hisshouhou! Mr. Magic.name: Jissen Pachi-Slot Hisshouhou! Mr. Magic Neo
Jissen Pachi-Slot Hisshouhou! Mr. Magic.summary: A virtual slots game for the PlayStation 2 that simulates the 2007 pachi-slot machine Mr. Magic Neo.

Kidou Senshi Gundam - Gundam vs. Z Gunda.name: Mobile Suit Gundam: Gundam vs. Zeta Gundam
Kidou Senshi Gundam - Gundam vs. Z Gunda.summary: Mobile Suit Gundam: Gundam vs. Zeta Gundam takes place seven years after the end of the devastating One-Year War, with the Titans police force assuming dictatorial powers. As the A.E.U.G. rebel group struggles to defeat the Titans, the heroes and villains of the original Mobile Suit Gundam series find themselves on the same side of this new conflict. You can choose whether to play as a member of the A.E.U.G. or Titans, and strap yourself into one of 31 new mobile suits. Practice your maneuvering skills in single-player story mode or take on a friend in multiplayer battles.

My Merry May.name: My Merry May
My Merry May.summary: Kyosuke is a high school student who lives a normal student's life in a dormitory until one day he receives a strange device from abroad. Inside the device is a female replis, an artificial human being. Kyosuke decides to awaken her, but before her personality is fully loaded, a thunderstorm briefly cuts the energy in the dormitory, creating a bug in Leu's system. Instead of his own personal servant, Kyosuke now has to take care of a teenager with a childlike mind. The remaining cast of heroines include Hitoe Haruna, Yasusuke's childhood friend, Motomi Agatsuma, the girlfriend of Kyosuke's best friend, Ryo Hagimoto, 21-year old Tae Kizuki, and her friend, 13-year old high school student Misao Yuki.

Sega Rally 2006.name: Sega Rally 2006
Sega Rally 2006.summary: A Sega Rally game released for PlayStation 2.

Tenshou Gakuen Gekkouroku.name: Tenshou Gakuen Gekkouroku
Tenshou Gakuen Gekkouroku.summary: The sequel to Tenshou Gakuen Gensouroku, taking place 5 years after the previous game.

Yumeria.name: Yumeria
Yumeria.summary: A visual novel for the PlayStation 2. It went on to spawn an anime series.
